items.title: Red Hat Security Advisory: ntp security update
products: Red Hat Enterprise Linux Desktop (v. 5 client)

fix.t: Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant to your system have been applied. This update is available via the Red Hat Netwo…
Issue these commands to explicitly generate a strong key and add it to the ntpd configuration: echo trustedkey 65535 >> /etc/ntp.conf printf "65535\tM\t%s\n" $…
Add these lines (included by default starting with Red Hat Enterprise Linux 5) to the configuration file /etc/ntp.conf: restrict default kod nomodify notrap no…
